movelist.name: Nasty Plot
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Dark Pulse
movelist.effect: Dark Pulse Flinches the target on 17+

movelist.name: Sucker Punch
movelist.effect: If an adjacent foe targets the user with a Damaging Attack, Sucker Punch may be used as an Interrupt Move against the triggering foe.

movelist.name: Swagger
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. Swagger Confuses the target.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls against adjacent targets.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.effect: Whenever the user has its Combat Stages lowered, by something other than its own Moves or Abilities, the user’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.effect: The user may use Status Moves as Priority (Advanced).
